subjects.description: What the primary subject(s) are, as seen in the provided image
subjects.appearance_details: Preserve exact appearance, shape, color, size, and identity from the provided image — do not invent details
subjects.relationship: Role and interaction with other subjects in the scene
subjects.location: Position as seen in the provided image
subjects.relative_size: Size relative to the frame, as seen in the provided image
subjects.orientation: Facing direction / orientation as seen in the provided image
subjects.pose: Physical pose or configuration as seen in the provided image
subjects.action: DETAILED motion description — specific direction, speed, trajectory, and interactions during the clip. This is the primary driver of what the model generates.
subjects.state_changes: How the subject's state changes during the clip
subjects.number_of_subjects: Count of distinct subjects of this type

background_setting: Environment description grounded in the provided image. Must include: 'Use the provided image as the exact first frame. Preserve all scene geometry, camera angle, and background elements unchanged throughout.'

lighting.conditions: As established in the provided image
lighting.sky: Sky appearance, if visible, consistent with the provided image

aesthetics.composition: Overall shot composition, matching the provided image
aesthetics.color_scheme: Color palette and tones, matching the provided image
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Overall mood conveyed by the scene
aesthetics.patterns: Recurring visual patterns or textures present in the scene

cinematography.camera_motion: State the camera behavior — by default the camera is fixed/locked; only describe motion if a motion-control checkpoint is being used
cinematography.framing: Shot framing, matching the provided image
cinematography.camera_angle: Camera angle, matching the provided image
cinematography.depth_of_field: Depth of field, matching the provided image
cinematography.focus: Focus characteristics, matching the provided image
cinematography.camera_preservation: State plainly: anchor to the provided image as the first frame and preserve its perspective and framing

artistic_style: Photorealistic style matching the provided image
context: One-sentence summary of what event or motion this clip depicts
negative_prompt: Comma-separated list of concepts to avoid — anything that would contradict the described action or alter scene structure/identity unexpectedly
